set.body: tools/premerge-check.sh step 7 currently fails every merge because it reports candidate commits on main first-parent even after their rows were truthfully reconciled to landed_out_of_band. Preserve the full-history bypass detector, but classify the matching candidate row: ignore only terminal landed and landed_out_of_band records; continue to fail pending, abandoned, superseded, unknown, duplicate, or unreadable matches. Add a hermetic mutation-style shell court covering each phase, duplicate-OID ambiguity, and candidate-list failure. Acceptance: test court green; current three reconciled commits no longer fail step 7; a synthetic pending direct-first-parent candidate still fails closed; prospective chief landing passes the complete premerge checker with its existing SHA-bound gate log.
set.title: P0 premerge: reconciled out-of-band landings must not remain gate-bypass failures
